tasks.label: compose: up api
args: set -euo pipefail; env_file=.env.local; if [ ! -f "$env_file" ] || ! grep -q '^EASYLOTTERY_ADMIN_TOKEN=' "$env_file"; then printf 'EASYLOTTERY_ADMIN_TOKEN=%s\n' "$(openssl rand -hex 32)" > "$env_file"; fi; docker compose --env-file "$env_file" up -d --build api

tasks.label: compose: rebuild api (no cache)
args: set -euo pipefail; env_file=.env.local; if [ ! -f "$env_file" ] || ! grep -q '^EASYLOTTERY_ADMIN_TOKEN=' "$env_file"; then printf 'EASYLOTTERY_ADMIN_TOKEN=%s\n' "$(openssl rand -hex 32)" > "$env_file"; fi; docker compose --env-file "$env_file" build --no-cache api && docker compose --env-file "$env_file" up -d api

tasks.label: compose: down api
args: set -euo pipefail; env_file=.env.local; if [ ! -f "$env_file" ] || ! grep -q '^EASYLOTTERY_ADMIN_TOKEN=' "$env_file"; then printf 'EASYLOTTERY_ADMIN_TOKEN=%s\n' "$(openssl rand -hex 32)" > "$env_file"; fi; docker compose --env-file "$env_file" down --remove-orphans
